meta.name: Taali
meta.description:
Based on the life of Transgender activist Gauri Sawant. Her daring transformation, incredible mootherhood and iconic battle that led to the inclusion of third gender on every official document in India.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 15 Aug 2023 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: GSEAMS Production · Network: JioCinema

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Teesri Ladai
videos.overview: Shreegauri Sawant, a transgender activist prepares for the third battle of her life, she recalls the first two; the battle for identity & survival. We start her journey from a 10-year-old boy Ganesh, who wants to grow up and be a mother.

videos.title: Two in One
videos.overview: Ganesh, after losing someone most dear to him, faces an identity crisis. It's now a battle of choosing between what people close to him want and what he desires. Shreegauri makes a shocking revelation about her relationship with her father.

videos.title: Rahi Chal Raha
videos.overview: Ganesh starts a new life in Mumbai. Just when he found a new family among the transgender community, he is challenged by a fiery transgender, Nargis. If he wins, it's his dream come true but failing would cost him his life.

videos.title: Gauri Aa Gayi
videos.overview: Ganesh becomes Shreegauri after undergoing a life-threatening operation. She rises from the ashes, she rescues a little girl from the clutches of evil forces and gives her a home. Gauri becomes a symbol, a social worker and even a threat.

videos.title: Gharaunda
videos.overview: Gauri's path breaking work for the community makes her a celebrity for many and an eyesore for some. Just when she is flying higher and higher, she is struck by an unrepairable loss that brings her crashing to the ground.

videos.title: Taali ki Goonj
videos.overview: Shreegauri recounts the dramatic and high-stake fight of her life when she and her community refuse to surrender to the powers. The Supreme Court delivers a historic judgment and everyone is ecstatic and someone close is cheering for her.
